# langsmith_workspace_role (Resource)

Manages a custom LangSmith workspace role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Clone a built-in role's permissions into a custom workspace role.
data "langsmith_workspace_role" "admin" {
  name = "WORKSPACE_ADMIN"
}

resource "langsmith_workspace_role" "example" {
  display_name = "Issues Agent (Replica)"
  description  = data.langsmith_workspace_role.admin.description
  permissions  = data.langsmith_workspace_role.admin.permissions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Role description.
- `display_name` (String) Role display name.
- `permissions` (List of String) Permissions assigned to this role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Role ID.
- `name` (String) Generated role name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID for this custom role.
